finding.issue: Inherited linkedCorrection percentage displays one approved-request ledger link divided by all8 recorded cases, including unfinished/integrity/unclassified cases, despite user unqualified reviewed-only percentage rule. Current four final HR outcome percentages have correct classified/resolved current-cycle denominators.
finding.userRule: Проценты считаются только по рассмотренным случаям; незавершённые случаи и размер выборки показываются отдельно.
finding.otherUserRule: Открытые, повторно открытые и неклассифицированные случаи не включай в знаменатель окончательных исходов.
finding.sourceEvidence: Accepted973 linkedCorrection.share intentionally uses all recorded cohort cases and explicitly states recorded-approved-request link, not current workday correction. Current C7 unchanged historical linkage API and accurately labelled screenshot12.5%=1of8. Roadmap WF-C6-010 includes correction rate among aggregate metrics.
finding.interpretation: Inherited descriptive association is not a false-positive or appeal outcome, and its all-case denominator is internally coherent. However, no explicit user exception authorizes that displayed percentage after broader newly approved reviewed-only percentage rule; prior implementation/synthetic acceptance cannot establish such exception.
finding.recommendedMinimalCorrection: Retain historical-link section, immutable all-recorded CASE_RECORDED_AT cohort and current API contract; replace historical percentage UI with localized linked count/total denominator. Leave final false-positive and full/partial/rejected percentage samples unchanged. Do not redefine historical denominator or infer correction approval means erroneous system outcome.
finding.requiredVerification: Update meaningful UI text/absence-of-historical-percent assertions; preserve exact historical numerator/denominator/API assertions, all final percent/null/sample/range/tenant/privacy/immutable tests and unchanged baseline gates. New final commit/fresh whole CI/browser/PG/review required.

priorReviewScope: Previous source/browser receipts remain immutable factual source/runtime bindings. This additive policy finding holds semantic whole acceptance; no old receipt rewritten or runtime failure invented.
authorship: Reviewer authored browser harness verification and diagnostic SQL/tests/workflows; this independent product-policy finding reviews root UI against user instructions and inherited source.
limitations: No user clarification or explicit waiver exists for historical all-cohort displayed percentage; recommendation uses authorized minimal implementation choice rather than inventing waiver.
Existing historical API linked ratio is descriptive and not automatically a personnel outcome. No actual production percentage/HR operational observation was collected.
